dedupe_keys.name: nasa harvest cropland maps of togo and kenya with hand labelled crop and non crop points

description: Three NASA Harvest releases of 10 m cropland maps and their training labels. The Zenodo records say the Togo release (May 2020) gives a 2019 cropland probability map from an LSTM classifier on Sentinel-2 time series, with hand-labelled crop and non-crop polygons and test data; the Kenya release (November 2020) gives a binary cropland map for the 2019-2020 season and one for Busia County for 2020-2021; and a third release (April 2021) gives hand-labelled crop and non-crop points for Ethiopia, Sudan, Togo and Kenya, with code on GitHub. All are free to download under CC BY 4.0; the Togo map is a 2.1 GB zip and the Kenya map 119 MB. Coverage is Togo and Kenya, with labels for four countries. Caveats: the maps are single-season model outputs. For simulation they give current cropland extent to map farm exposure to drought and floods where national maps are lacking. A related catalogue record is the Radiant Earth African crop type reference data.
